local_work: Exact all-size rational attainment criterion gcd(a+1,210)>1; smooth necessity via actual Picard-class injection and Mazur; singular necessity via a two-element Galois orbit of a multiplicative gluing parameter; four explicit prime-order integer recurrence certificates and a direct characteristic-zero full-rank witness.
field_and_hypotheses: Exact classification over Q, balanced crossed source a>=3, nonzero quadratic-in-z slices with coefficient degrees below a. Integer prime-order identities separately give orders 2,3,5 over every field and order 7 in characteristic other than 2. No exact classification outside Q is asserted.
finite_evidence: Four exact rational recurrence ranks, four supplied/nonzero integer tuples, thirteen polynomial equations and ten full rational source matrices. One separate F2 a=3 source verifies that the order-seven polynomial collapses to primitive degree zero in characteristic two. No discovery search is rerun.
discovery_boundary: The order-five and order-seven vectors were supplied by the parent discovery run. Their exact receipts are preserved and pinned; the maintained verifier reconstructs matrices and checks vectors without importing a prior verifier. This is same-session checking, not independent review.
prior_credit: The construction and all inherited local results retain their earlier credits. Jacobian existence and injection are credited to Milne; rational elliptic torsion classification is Mazur's theorem; singular unit-sequence facts are credited to the Stacks Project. No historical-priority claim is made.
limitations: A single crossed biform source family, not the full cyclic source for a>3, a compatible target construction, degeneration, or matrix-multiplication exponent improvement. No unmerged split-family dependency and no assertion that every relevant torsion order divides 210.
